data.action: 提着草帽散步，晚风拂过裙摆
data.description: 【塞西莉亚 · 河畔黄昏散步】夕阳西下的清凉河畔草坡上，塞西莉亚提着草帽赤脚踩在柔软的浅草间，晚风吹拂着她轻盈的白色长裙。她转过身拉住你的手，金色眼眸中映着整片晚霞——「镇上的人们都说圣女带来了奇迹……但对我而言，能遇到劳伦斯才是世界上最棒的奇迹。」
data.promptProse: Cecilia walks barefoot through short grass on the riverbank in her light floral sundress, carrying her straw hat before turning to take Lawrence's hand. The medium view includes their touching hands and the grassy slope continuing to the river behind. Warm sunset lights her skirt edge and gentle face, while the water reflects the evening sky and soft grass shadows lie across her feet.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 河畔黄昏散步
